description: This Java class defines a Fragment named LogFragment used in an Android application to display log data through a custom LogView. It manages view creation, layout setup, and auto-scrolling behavior for logs.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that contains a LogView for displaying logs and manages auto-scrolling behavior when logs are updated.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Initializes and arranges the ScrollView and LogView components, setting layout parameters, styles, and padding.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the view hierarchy, adds a text change listener to auto-scroll logs, and returns the root view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance managed by the fragment.
